results.description:
# Healthcare Award Pay Rates 2026: Employer Compliance Guide
- From 1 July 2026, all award rates increased by 4.75% following the Fair Work Commission Annual Wage Review — Support Services Level 1 starts at $26.97/hour
- Saturday and Sunday penalty rates are 150% for full-time and part-time (175% for casuals); public holidays are 250% (275% casual)

Support Services Level 1 now starts at $26.97 per hour ($1,024.70 per week for 38 hours), with higher rates for each subsequent level.

## MA000027 Pay Rates From 1 July 2026
| Classification | Hourly Rate | Weekly Rate (38h) |
|-|-|-|
| Level 1 (support services) | $26.97 | $1,024.70 |
| Level 2 (support services) | $28.03 | $1,065.20 |
| Level 3 (support services) | $29.11 | $1,106.20 |
| Level 4 (support services) | $29.45 | $1,119.10 |
| Level 5 (support services) | $30.45 | $1,157.20 |
| Level 6 (support services) | $32.09 | $1,219.50 |

## Penalty Rates and Shift Loading
Overtime is paid at 150% for the first 2 hours and 200% after that.

- ✓Support Services Level 1 minimum rate from 1 July 2026 is $26.97/hour ($1,024.70/week for 38 hours)

## Frequently Asked Questions
From 1 July 2026, Support Services Level 1 earns $26.97/hour ($1,024.70/week), Level 2 earns $28.03/hour ($1,065.20/week), Level 3 earns $29.11/hour ($1,106.20/week), Level 4 earns $29.45/hour ($1,119.10/week), and Level 5 earns $30.45/hour ($1,157.20/week).

Under MA000027, Saturday work pays 150% of the minimum hourly rate for full-time and part-time employees, and 175% for casuals (which includes the 25% casual loading). Sunday work pays the same: 150% for full-time and part-time, 175% for casuals. Public holidays pay 250% for full-time and part-time, and 275% for casuals.

This affects health professionals such as physiotherapists, occupational therapists, psychologists, speech pathologists and podiatrists.

Overtime under MA000027 is paid at 150% of the minimum hourly rate for the first 2 hours and 200% after that.
